paper.title_en: Neutron Portal and Dark Matter-Baryon Coincidence: from UV Completion to Phenomenology
paper.abstract_en: We present a dynamical solution to the dark matter-baryon coincidence problem based on the neutron portal operator connecting the visible and dark sector asymmetries. This framework is motivated by the possibility that a strongly supercooled dark confinement phase transition accounts for the nano-Hz stochastic gravitational wave signal observed by pulsar timing arrays, while also generating the dark matter and baryon asymmetry in the Universe. We show that the GeV-scale mass of asymmetric dark matter can be naturally correlated with the (multi-)TeV scale cut-off for the neutron portal through its ultraviolet completion. The dark sector is governed by an approximate fixed point and confines once the heavy portal states are integrated out, dynamically generating a scale of $\mathcal{O} ({\rm GeV})$. We analyze both tree and loop-level ultraviolet completions and demonstrate how the resulting confinement scale is linked to the effective neutron portal scale. We also discuss cosmological constraints and experimental prospects in beam dump searches and colliders for probing the neutron portal.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文提出一种基于中子门户算符的动态解决方案来解释暗物质-重子巧合问题，并联系了由强超冷却暗色禁闭相变产生的纳赫兹随机引力波信号（与脉冲星计时阵列观测相关）。该方案涉及紫外完备化、固定点和动力学尺度生成，具有较深的理论构建和潜在的现象学意义。尽管主要方向是粒子物理和宇宙学，但其与脉冲星计时阵列引力波信号的直接关联，使其在相关领域具有较高价值。
decision.title_zh: 中子门户与暗物质-重子巧合：从紫外完备化到现象学
decision.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种基于中子门户算符连接可见与暗部门不对称性的暗物质-重子巧合问题的动态解决方案。此框架的动机在于，强超冷却的暗色禁闭相变可能解释脉冲星计时阵列观测到的纳赫兹随机引力波信号，同时产生宇宙中的暗物质和重子不对称性。我们证明，通过其紫外完备化，吉电子伏量级的非对称暗物质质量可以自然地与中子门户的（多）太电子伏量级截断相关。暗部门受近似固定点控制，并在重门户态被积出后发生禁闭，动态生成 $\mathcal{O} ({\rm GeV})$ 的量级。我们分析了树图和圈图水平的紫外完备化，并展示了由此产生的禁闭尺度如何与有效中子门户尺度相联系。我们还讨论了宇宙学约束以及束流转储实验和对撞机中探测中子门户的实验前景。
